_description: Input Range and OVP Test Configuration
_instructions: Edit values below instead of modifying the Python code. Re-run the test to pick up changes.

instrument_addresses._note: VISA address strings for each instrument

output_dir._note: Full path where results should be saved. Use forward slashes. Example: D:/Results/input_range_ovp

instrument_settings._note: PSU channel selection (1, 2, or 3) and instrument communication timeouts (milliseconds)

fixed_vin_tests._note: Apply vin_v on PSU, wait, read DMM, check Vout vs expected_vout_v +/- vout_tolerance_v
